row: The Open College of Equine Studies

Distance and blended learning courses.

The Open College of Equine Studies (TOCES) specialises in equine management, equine science and equine veterinary nursing distance and blended learning courses. TOCES learners are based all over the world and their ages range from 16 to 69!

Based in England, TOCES is an independent international distance learning college specialising in equine study programmes. Learners all over the world are able to study and learn via printed and online course materials. Some programmes include study weeks during which course notes are supplemented with lectures from subject experts. Practical skills are taught and assessed.

General Equine Programmes: www.equinestudies.co.uk

Equine Veterinary Nursing Programmes: https://www.equinestudies.co.uk/veterinary-nursing/
